Retrieve CDASH model or implementation-guide variable metadata

Source: R/get_cdash.R
get_cdash.Rd

Accessor over the two CDASH (collection-side) tables, cdash_model and ig_cdash, with the same conventions as get_ig: the standard is chosen with standard and the version defaults to its newest. CDASH is kept apart from get_ig() because its tables describe case report form collection (question text, prompts, the SDTM variable each field maps to), not a dataset's structure, and so have different columns.

Usage

get_cdash(standard = "CDASHIG", version = NULL, domain = NULL)

Arguments

standard

"CDASHIG" (default) or "CDASH".

version

A version string of that standard (e.g. "2.3"). NULL (the default) uses the newest, compared numerically.

domain

Restrict to one domain (e.g. "LB"); for "CDASH" a class (e.g. "Findings") is accepted too. NULL (the default) applies no filter.

Value

A data frame: the rows of cdash_model or ig_cdash for that standard, version, and domain. An unknown standard, version, or domain is a classed error (cdiscdata_error_ig_standard_unavailable, cdiscdata_error_ig_version_unavailable, cdiscdata_error_ig_domain_unavailable).

Details

The standards: "CDASH" (the CDASH model, versions 1.0 to 1.3, in cdash_model) and "CDASHIG" (the CDASH implementation guide, 1.1 and 2.0 to 2.3, in ig_cdash).

Like the other implementation-guide data these come from CDISC Library CSV exports that are not part of this package or repository (see ig_sources); the guides' definitions, CRF completion instructions, mapping instructions, and implementation notes are not carried. The collection wording the guides publish (question_text, prompt) is.

Examples

get_cdash()                                  # newest CDASHIG (2.3)
#>      standard version           class domain
#> 3231  CDASHIG     2.3   Interventions     AG
#> 3232  CDASHIG     2.3   Interventions     AG
